notes.title: Game issues/BUG centralized posting
notes.content:
Game issues/BUG centralized posting

First, I will focus on some of the problems that you may encounter in the game.

1. Basic shortcut key description. [F4] Full screen/window switching, [F11] Back to the title screen, [Space bar] to skip the current event.
These kinds of shortcut keys can be found in game.ini in the game folder. If you want to modify, please open it directly with Notepad and modify it to the target key value, and then save it.

2. The mouse cannot be used after full screen. Modify the [HardwareFullScreen=1] field of game.ini in the game folder, and change the last number [1] to [0] to use the mouse. However, due to the lack of compatibility of the engine with certain hardware, some players may encounter problems such as the game's playback event stuck. If you encounter such problems, you can click the space bar on the keyboard to skip.

3. For some controllers that are not supported, please also modify the [GamePadDInput=0] field of game.ini in the game folder, change the last number to [1], and then test whether your current controller is supported.

If you have any other questions, please leave a message under this post, or send an email to the customer service mailbox [razgr1z@hotmail.com]
we will reply as soon as possible.
